info.title: Authorized manual experience library
info.description: Scope authorization precedes search and pagination. Candidates require experience maintenance; independent authored copy publication requires explicit confirmation. Evidence never conveys source authority. Usage and feedback are actor-private, exact-version self reports, not evaluation results. Search uses rebuildable indexed keywords; empty results do not block work.
